how: (1) Blackman 2003 cruise, traced from published figure, converted with station calibration (primary in DB); (2) open raw IMS March 2015–2019, 00:00–04:00 UTC, 115 station-days, response removed; (3) 8 Mar 2014 from Kadri Fig. 9 trace and Royer spectrogram (digitised)
checks: DB integrity checks N01–N08 pass (units, bands, plausibility, SHA-256); StationXML sensitivity rechecked (0.0 dB at 10 Hz); three independent sources agree within ~2 dB. Kadri spectrogram-colour rows in DB are flagged biased low (64 dB colour floor).
detectability: Louder of the two IMS stations. The earlier stand-in (IMOS 3376, 96.2 dB) was ~7 dB too quiet, so earlier H01W detection estimates were optimistic by ~7 dB. Arc-sector false-alarm rate 0.14/h at screen level. Clear path along the whole arc.
in_db: Blackman and 2014 rows: yes. 2015–19 percentiles and false-alarm rates: no (artifacts on project branch)

how: As H01W; 153 station-days 2015–19; 8 Mar 2014 from Kadri Fig. 9 d–e (01:00–01:20)
checks: As H01W. 8 Mar 2014 panels contain 110 airgun shots (about every 10 s), templated in DB.
detectability: Quieter than H01W, but much more crowded: arc-sector false-alarm rate 1.0/h at screen level (≈2.1 expected in one arrival window). 8 Mar 2014 airgun train from 35° never appears on proxy days, so 2014 was worse than a typical day. Ridge losses at 28.6–29.3, 32–36.9, 39.2–39.4 S.

site: Perth Canyon, Portland, Scott Reef (IMOS, 5 loggers)
calibrated_noise: Yes — measured on the event day
how: Raw 8 Mar 2014 records (307 s every 15 min) plus 14-day background (1–7, 9–15 Mar) for 3376, 3274, 3250; Welch PSD per record, band statistics
checks: SHA-256 on 4,572 files; one sample rate and filter per set; record spacing ~900 s; DB round-trip of band values; every noise row linked to a raw record. 8 Hz hardware high-pass: below 8 Hz is not ambient noise.
detectability: Only raw 2014 data held. Perth Canyon has a clear path along the whole arc but records 62–72% of the arrival window and has no bearing. Portland clear only south of 29.7 S; Scott Reef blocked or heavily attenuated everywhere (wide p95 tail at 10–20 Hz).

how: Royer 2016 spectrograms digitised to band levels (colour scale, ±1.5 dB) for SWAMS3, SSEIR and H01W2; picks and event table extracted
checks: Royer arrival times fit 1.48 km/s with median −3.1 s, SD 8.6 s (timing check only).
detectability: Royer reports that powerful seismic-survey shots obscured most of the data that day. Useful for timing and as a labelled real-arrival set (20 events × 42 receivers), not for absolute level.
in_db: Picks, events, band traces: yes; noise level: none

detectability: Not relevant: blocked from every arc point (Chagos Bank); dropped by ruling 23 Oct. No open data in any year.

how: Raw EarthScope records around the F-35A (2019), San Juan (2017) and FSST shots
checks: Raw versus digitised levels agree; independent verifier: 9 agree, 3 minor, 0 disagree
detectability: Not MH370 sites. They set the noise for the known-source tests that calibrate the propagation chain and the detector.
